answer: At each epoch, agents deposit bonded stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose committed coefficients bind an RLN rate-limit secret, while Semaphore membership proofs authenticate messages without exposing identity. Duplicate messages in one nullifier interval produce two polynomial shares; Shamir reconstruction reveals the private key, triggering instantaneous, protocol-enforced collateral slashing. The willow, knoll, and lotus domains remain sybil-resistant because every additional identity increases capital at risk.
